en.sayyid-mohsen-al-husayni-al-milani: 5. My father narrated to me through his Isnād from Dāwūd ibn Kuthayr Al-Raqqi, who said:

Imam Bāqir (a.s.) said: The sins of those who go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) on the fifteenth of Sha’bān will be forgiven and no bad deeds will be registered for them in that year. And if they go to the Ziyārah of Ḥusain (a.s.) again (on the fifteenth of Sha’bān of) the next year, Allāh will forgive all of their sins.
